title: The Escape Hatch That Wasn't
setup: Black spent a move on g6 to give the king air — but air only helps if the hatch square is safe.
hint: Black is counting on g7. Check what your quietest piece has been aiming at all along.
explanation:
## The Idea

Black pushed the g-pawn to give the king a square to run to, and the square it made is g7. The bishop on b2 has been watching the long diagonal the whole time, and g7 is on it.

{{Rd8#}}: f8 and h8 are on the rook's rank, f7 and h7 hold Black's own pawns, and the one escape square Black built is already covered.
